title: Role recipe (v1)
description: Schema for `.tera/roles/<name>.hcl` recipes per ADR-060 §1. A role is a named bundle of `grant` and `deny` blocks, each in the ADR-010 vocabulary (actions + hierarchical resource patterns). Roles compile deterministically to an ordered ACL ruleset enforced by the unchanged ADR-010 ACLAuthorizer; a `role_binding` maps subjects to roles. The recipe declares a single `role` block whose label becomes `name`.

version.description: Per-recipe grammar version. Required; this schema applies when version is v1.

name.description: Bare role name (the HCL block label). The loader namespaces it as <vault-id>/roles/<name>.

grant.description: Allow grants. Each entry authorizes the listed actions over the listed resource patterns for any subject bound to this role.

actions.description: ADR-010 actions. * expands to the full set (connect, publish, subscribe, invoke). This vocabulary is CLOSED and the loader enforces it: a token outside the list is refused when the recipe loads, naming the token, the file and the valid set. It used to be dropped in silence, so a grant naming only a misspelling compiled to an empty action list — a role that granted nothing, from a recipe that loaded clean. A misspelling beside a valid token is refused for the same reason rather than narrowed to the tokens that parsed.

resources.description: Hierarchical resource patterns (ADR-010): tools/#, api/v1/config/apply, extensions/authenticator/#, topic patterns, etc.

scope.description: Reserved tenancy namespace (ADR-060 §7). Defaults to the single global scope in v1; carries no behaviour yet.

deny.description: Deny grants. ADR-060 §1 deny-overrides: every deny from any role a subject holds compiles ahead of every allow.
